description: Twelve access units of a 2/0 independent substream (spectral extension, no noise) and a dependent substream with the channel map of the back left and back right pair, also 2/0: a program of four channels, which decoders that read dependent substreams give in the order front left, front right, back left, back right (A/52 Annex E 3.8).

skip.decode: FFmpeg decodes the independent substream only (its 2 channels); Core Audio's output is the reference for the four (macOS job).
skip.ffprobe_fields: FFmpeg reports the independent substream's channels.
skip.ffprobe_bitrate: FFmpeg gives no bitrate for frames it cannot decode.
skip.skip_insertion: The check rewrites E-AC-3 frames with skip fields.
